target_customer: Hotels from independents to groups that miss or mishandle phone calls
problem: Hotel phone lines are overwhelmed and staffed thinly; legacy IVRs frustrate callers and lose bookings.
business_model: B2B SaaS in three tiers (Boutique, Property, Portfolio) with a 14 day free trial

founders.name: Shaun Lane
previous_startups: Travel consulting and content creation business

competitors.name: Canary Technologies AI Voice
competitors.what: End to end AI voice platform for hotels (front desk, concierge, reservations)
competitors.traction_then: launched Feb 2025, installed Canary customer base

competitors.name: Visito Voice
competitors.what: AI phone call agent for independent hotels

competitors.name: The Hotels Network KITT
competitors.what: AI voice receptionist for reservations and info

competitors.name: Nonius Voice AI Receptionist
competitors.what: AI receptionist added to cloud PBX

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time voice models are available off the shelf; hard parts are integration with fragmented hotel PMS, reservation and dining systems and low latency multilingual handling.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations help but several funded hotel software vendors launched similar voice agents within weeks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Canary launched an end to end AI voice platform in Feb 2025, the month after the W25 batch began.

market_need_then: Hotels cannot staff phones around the clock and callers hang up; the company claims hotels lose revenue when lines are overwhelmed (company claim, no external data found).

identity.visual_style: Sans serif with italic accent phrases
identity.voice_and_tone: Short bold headlines such as 'Every guest, answered instantly'

brand_strength.rationale: Name fits travel and hospitality, but it is shared by many brands (yachts, restaurants, hotels) and no brand press was found.

outcome_analysis: Riviera is an active Winter 2025 company selling a hotel voice agent. Funding is only visible in aggregators and no traction numbers were found. Several competitors, including the incumbent Canary Technologies, launched similar products at about the same time, so differentiation will depend on integrations and execution; no exit or shutdown news was found.
notes: VCBacked reports 500K pre-seed in March 2025 and Crunchbase shows only a pre-seed with YC; both are aggregators with no primary announcement, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Founder bios come from the YC page. Completeness pass: the 500K March 2025 pre-seed rests on a single database (VCBacked).
